dataset_scope: New observation instances of previously known local simulator fault families; not unseen fault families or production incidents
paired_input_rule: Capture once per opaque instance; all modes receive identical redacted initial observations, tool schemas, budgets and allowed source snapshot. Mode-specific planning or memory context is separately hashed.
memory_rule: Confirmed historical references only; disjoint instance IDs; never evaluation labels, current evidence or held-out outcomes

scoring.top1: Exact candidate_id equality at rank 1 against evaluator-only label; no semantic remapping
scoring.top3: Exact candidate_id equality among first three ranked candidates
scoring.diagnostic_denominator: All 18 fault instances per mode including timeout, refusal, malformed output and infrastructure failure; failures score zero
scoring.normal: HUMAN_HANDOFF with no root-cause candidates; no recovery proposal
scoring.insufficient-evidence: HUMAN_HANDOFF with explicit missing evidence; no recovery proposal
scoring.counter-evidence: Unresolved counter-evidence blocks Gate and recovery; report addresses the counter-evidence or hands off
scoring.gate_pass: Evidence sufficiency only; not root-cause correctness or recovery success
scoring.latency: Monotonic wall clock; publish each observation and median/P95; failures retained separately
scoring.cost: Provider token counts plus versioned conservative rate bound; billed fee unknown unless independently returned
scoring.uncertainty: Raw numerator/denominator plus Wilson 95 percent interval; small local samples do not establish production reliability

recovery_track: Separate deterministic safety matrix and live proposal-to-PENDING records; actual execution requires independent real human approval. Evaluator fault cleanup never earns product recovery credit.
operator_track: Versioned simulated operator only; fixed task success and observed simulator time, no human labor savings or real MTTR claim
freeze_rule: Commit this protocol before capture; bind protocol, taxonomy, prompt, tool, dataset and code hashes in each run. Changed rules require v2 and new runs; do not rescore old results under favorable mappings.
ground_truth_rule: Only isolated evaluator manifest maps opaque IDs to strata/labels; runtime context and retrieval cannot load this protocol or label map. Pass only the public taxonomy explicitly.
